from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        coord = operator.StarWithCoordinator(
            worker_llm=self.llm,
            coordinator_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            worker_prompts=[
                prompt_custom.HC_COORD_SCREEN_PROMPT,
                prompt_custom.HC_COORD_CONSTRUCT_PROMPT,
                prompt_custom.HC_COORD_SCREEN_PROMPT,
            ],
            coordinator_prompt=prompt_custom.HC_COORDINATOR_PROMPT,
            n_rounds=2,
        )
        brief = await coord(problem)
        debate = operator.DebateWithModerator(
            worker_llm=self.llm,
            moderator_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            agent_prompts=[
                prompt_custom.HC_DEBATE_CONSTRUCT_PROMPT,
                prompt_custom.HC_DEBATE_CONTRADICTION_PROMPT,
                prompt_custom.HC_DEBATE_REPAIR_PROMPT,
            ],
            moderator_prompt=prompt_custom.HC_MODERATOR_FINAL_PROMPT,
            n_rounds=3,
        )
        solution = await debate(problem + "\n\nCoordinator brief:\n" + (brief["response"] or "Graph status unresolved; verify degrees, connectivity, and exact cycle edges."))
        return solution["response"] or "```text\nNO\n```", {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta() or {},
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta() or {},
        }
